CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scribeswell.cleanup_corpus_write_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 DELETE FROM scribeswell.corpus_write_binding WHERE login=NEW.login
 AND backend_pid=NEW.backend_pid AND transaction_id=NEW.transaction_id;
 RETURN NULL;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scribeswell.execute_corpus_command(request jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT scribeswell.corpus_command_internal(request,false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scribeswell.lookup_corpus_command_outcome(request jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT scribeswell.corpus_command_internal(request,true)
$function$
